subject: Autonomous insulin-dose recommendation prohibited
decision: LibreCare must not autonomously compute or recommend an individual insulin dose from AI, CGM trends, or incomplete context.
reason: This is a hard safety and regulatory boundary to prevent harmful clinical suggestions without clinician-approved protocols.
evidence: SAFETY_GUARDRAILS.md states this as a binding prohibition.
counterargument: Automatic dose suggestions may appear convenient, but they introduce unacceptable clinical and safety risk.
revisit_condition: Revisit only within a dedicated, clinician-approved safety/regulatory project with explicit governance.
